title: Calico semantic-model inventory (v1)
description: Closed retained inspection record covering the complete Publish-to-web semantic model, including hidden columns, relationships, and transitive calculated/measure base lineage (D-21/D-22/D-30). No expression bodies or source values. Names use bounded characters so findings cannot echo paths, contacts, or log-control characters. The checker additionally enforces unique table/field names, source-column self-lineage, and all base references against the publication allowlist. Numeric schema_version must decode to a Python integer, not a boolean or float.

schema_version.description: Fixed version of the exposure record.

model_name.description: Safe model label; every space-separated word begins with a letter, excluding standalone numeric value tokens.

inventory_source.description: Retain either machine metadata or the owner's complete manual attestation.

tables.description: Every model table, including tables absent from visible report pages.

relationships.description: Every exposed model relationship, even when no chart uses it.

table_name.description: Exact export name; unapproved model tables fail the exposure check.

fields.description: Complete unique field inventory including hidden columns and measures.

field_name.description: Safe unique field label; each space-separated word begins with a letter so findings cannot echo standalone numeric value tokens.

visibility.description: Hidden fields remain exposed by Publish to web and are always checked.

origin.description: Source fields require their exact self-pair; derived fields require transitive base lineage.

lineage_complete.description: Producer attests the complete transitive source set; absent or false fails closed.

source_columns.description: Complete distinct base references, including hidden dependencies; no expression parsing.

table_name.description: Exact approved export carrying the transitive base source.

column_name.description: Exact approved base column; never a source value or expression.

from_table.description: Relationship source must be an approved exported table.

from_column.description: Relationship source key must be an approved exported column.

to_table.description: Relationship destination must be an approved exported table.

to_column.description: Relationship destination key must be an approved exported column.

cardinality.description: Closed supported cardinalities expose the model's join structure.

cross_filter_direction.description: Retained filtering direction makes cross-table exposure inspectable.
